component.name: Ginrose
component.summary: Run the official macOS Roblox client on Linux

description.p: Ginrose runs the official macOS Roblox client on Linux through Rosemary, a macOS compatibility layer. It downloads the client straight from Roblox, keeps it up to date, sets it up to run well and shows what you are playing on Discord.
The client is never modified, and Ginrose refuses to run one that was: before every launch it checks Roblox's own code signature on every file.
